reasoning: In a graph with girth at least 8, the neighborhood ball of radius 3 around any vertex of degree d must form a tree (no cycles of length at most 6), requiring at least 1 + d + d(d-1) + d(d-1)^2 vertices. For d >= 3 this is at least 22 > 16, so maximum degree is 2. Thus the graph is a disjoint union of paths and cycles of length >=8. The maximum edges occurs with a single 16-cycle (or two 8-cycles), yielding at most 16 edges. Since 20 > 16, no such graph exists.
